title: VFIG: Vectorizing Complex Figures in SVG with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.24575v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for technical illustration and digital design, offering resolution independence and semantic editability. In practice, original vector files are frequently lost, leaving only rasterized versions (e.g., PNG, JPEG) that resist modification, while manual reconstruction is prohibitively expensive. Progress on automating raster-to-SVG conversion has been bottlenecked by two gaps: existing SVG datasets are dominated by icons and decorative graphics that lack the complexity of professional diagrams, and existing benchmarks rely on pixel- or embedding-level similarity that fails to capture structural correctness (e.g., broken connectivity, misplaced arrows). We close both gaps with paired contributions targeting diagram-centric figures (e.g., model architectures, flowcharts, schematics). translated_title: VFIG：利用视觉-语言模型将复杂图形矢量化为SVG格式
translated_abstract: 摘要：可缩放矢量图形（SVG）对于技术插图和数字设计至关重要，具有分辨率无关性和语义可编辑性。在实际应用中，原始矢量文件经常丢失，仅留下难以修改的栅格化版本（如PNG、JPEG），而手动重建成本过高。自动化栅格到SVG转换的进展受到两个瓶颈的限制：现有SVG数据集以图标和装饰性图形为主，缺乏专业图表的复杂性；现有基准依赖像素级或嵌入级相似度，无法捕捉结构正确性（如断裂的连接、错位的箭头）。我们通过针对图表中心图形（如模型架构、流程图、示意图）的配对贡献来弥补这两个缺口。在训练方面，我们引入了VFIG-Data，这是同类中最大的图形到SVG数据集，包含66K对，结合了...
tldr: 本文提出VFIG方法，通过引入大规模图表中心数据集VFIG-Data，并利用视觉-语言模型，解决了复杂图形从栅格到SVG矢量化的结构正确性难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VFIG, which leverages vision-language models and a large-scale diagram-centric dataset VFIG-Data to address structural correctness in raster-to-SVG vectorization of complex figures.
